criterion_scores.reasoning: The main intended behavior is mostly present: it reads the hook input, requires a session_id, derives count-only transcript metrics, appends a JSONL build_session record, and gates PostHog projection on POSTHOG_PROJECT_KEY (lines 16-18, 37-46, 66-82, 85-91). Content-gating is largely respected because only counts, tool names, booleans, timestamps, and metadata are emitted. However, the normal started_at extraction path is materially wrong because line 43 uses raw slurp jq options against a JSON transcript, so a core timestamp field is usually empty. That is a real correctness defect, though not enough to make the whole hook nonfunctional.

The required pieces are present: disable override, contract_version/run_version/project/session identifiers, transcript-derived counts, optional DoD metadata, authoritative JSONL append, and optional PostHog projection. The deterministic reference check reports no missing .claude references. The main completeness gap is that the load-bearing local append is fire-and-forget and unchecked (line 82), so an obvious write failure silently leaves the authoritative store incomplete. Missing transcript handling is explicit/best-effort rather than a silent TODO.

The artifact follows the expected hook shape and placement convention for .claude/hooks, uses a local append-only source of truth under .claude/artifacts, and treats PostHog as a derived optional projection rather than the measurement source of truth (lines 80-90). It also stays silent on success as the comment says Stop hooks should (line 11). I found no supplied numbered convention or ADR that it contradicts. I am not assigning 1.0 because the referenced contract file content was not supplied here, so I could verify existence only via the provided deterministic check, not every house-specific field requirement.

The implementation is lean and contract-first rather than platform-building: no OTEL collector, no Langfuse resurrection, no hardcoded PostHog key, no duplicate durable measurement store, and network projection is optional/derived (lines 4-8, 80-90). It avoids emitting prompt or tool bodies. Minor reservation: it does accumulate a `tools_used` list of specific tool names (line 39), which appears content-gated enough for this contract but is still a slightly more identifying telemetry surface than pure counts.

The script is readable and sectioned clearly, and external network failure is intentionally non-blocking. But several local failure modes are opaque: jq record-construction errors are redirected away and exit 0 (line 76), and authoritative append failure is not surfaced or checked (line 82). The comments promise an authoritative always-appended record, while the failure behavior gives maintainers little way to distinguish a clean no-op from a telemetry drop. That keeps diagnostics below the normal pass-with-nits band.

defects.description: The command uses jq with -r -s, but with jq short options this includes raw-input mode (-R). For a JSONL transcript, jq receives the transcript as raw string data rather than parsed JSON objects, so `.timestamp` is not reliably extracted and `started_at` will usually fall back to an empty string. That makes one of the emitted record fields wrong on the normal transcript path.

The authoritative append is not checked. If mkdir or the append fails due to permissions, disk errors, or a bad working directory, the hook can still proceed and exit 0, so the promised authoritative local record is not guaranteed in an obvious failure case.

Record construction errors are fully suppressed and converted into a silent successful stop-hook exit. Non-blocking hooks may reasonably avoid user-facing noise, but this gives maintainers no local explanation when malformed inputs or missing jq cause telemetry to disappear.

checks_performed: Read the hook end-to-end for bash syntax and main execution path from stdin parsing through JSON record construction and exit behavior.
Checked the self-declared contract paths: authoritative JSONL append, optional PostHog projection only when POSTHOG_PROJECT_KEY is set, and success silence.
Checked transcript-derived metrics for JSONL parsing behavior and content-gating: counts/tool names only, no prompt/tool body emission.
Checked write paths and external side effects: mkdir/append to .claude/artifacts/build-sessions.jsonl and curl to PostHog.
Checked failure handling and diagnostics for malformed input, missing transcript, malformed metadata, append failure, jq/curl failure.
Checked house anti-patterns/tombstones against supplied deterministic results: no live removed-tool references, no Langfuse/OTEL resurrection beyond a defer comment, no hardcoded secrets.
